-- in --
package main

templ x(items []string) {
	<div>
	<span></span>

	if true {
					<span>Test</span>
		} else {

					<span>Test</span>
			}



		for _, item := range items {

			<div>{ item }</div>
		}

		if true {
			<span>Test</span>
		}

		for _, item := range items {
			<div>{ item }</div>
		}
		switch items[0] {


			case "a":
				<div>{ items[0] }</div>

				<div>{ items[0] }</div>
			case "b":
				<div>{ items[1] }</div>
		}


		<span>Foo Bar </span>
	</div>
}
-- out --
package main

templ x(items []string) {
	<div>
		<span></span>

		if true {
			<span>Test</span>
		} else {
			<span>Test</span>
		}

		for _, item := range items {
			<div>{ item }</div>
		}

		if true {
			<span>Test</span>
		}

		for _, item := range items {
			<div>{ item }</div>
		}
		switch items[0] {
			case "a":
				<div>{ items[0] }</div>

				<div>{ items[0] }</div>
			case "b":
				<div>{ items[1] }</div>
		}

		<span>Foo Bar </span>
	</div>
}
